description: This file defines the interface S3ClientInterface within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifying methods for interacting with Amazon S3 such as creating presigned requests, checking existence of buckets and objects, uploading, copying, and deleting objects, as well as downloading buckets and determining bucket regions.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Creates a pre-signed URL for a given S3 command object, valid until the specified expiration time.

methods.name: getObjectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to an S3 object given its bucket and key.

methods.name: doesBucketExist
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if a bucket exists by name.

methods.name: doesBucketExistV2
methods.description: Checks whether a specified bucket exists using S3's HeadBucket operation, with an option to accept 403 errors.

methods.name: doesObjectExist
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if an object exists in a bucket.

methods.name: doesObjectExistV2
methods.description: Checks whether a specified object exists in a bucket, considering delete markers if specified.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapper
methods.description: Registers the Amazon S3 stream wrapper with this client instance.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapperV2
methods.description: Registers the S3 stream wrapper, using existence checks via doesObjectExistV2 and doesBucketExistV2.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjects
methods.description: Deletes objects from S3 matching criteria like prefix or regex, used for batch deletions.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjectsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes objects matching specified criteria from S3.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads a file, stream, or string to a specified S3 bucket and key.

methods.name: uploadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads a file, stream, or string to S3.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies an object from one location to another within S3, supporting multipart copy if needed.

methods.name: copyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously copies an object within S3.

methods.name: uploadDirectory
methods.description: Recursively uploads all files in a local directory to an S3 bucket.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads a directory to S3.

methods.name: downloadBucket
methods.description: Downloads the entire contents of a bucket to a local directory.

methods.name: downloadBucketAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads the contents of a bucket to a local directory.

methods.name: determineBucketRegion
methods.description: Returns the AWS region where a specified bucket is located.

methods.name: determineBucketRegionAsync
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to the region where a bucket is located.
